title: Hartford Founded
description: Thomas Hooker leads a congregation from the Massachusetts Bay Colony to establish Hartford along the Connecticut River.

title: Connecticut Royal Charter
description: King Charles II grants the colony's charter; Hartford's boundaries are formally surveyed.

title: First Federal Census
description: Hartford records its first census data

title: Great Migration Reaches Hartford
description: The first major wave of African American migrants from the South arrives seeking wartime industrial work.

title: Federal Fair Housing Act
